title: St. Paul's Living Sanctuary: Visual Music of Nature (6 Architectural Nature Looks Test Reel)

looks_6.hud_title: LOOK 1 (00:00-00:30): MYCELIUM TO MILKY WAY - Subterranean Root-Light Pulse -> Open Aurora Borealis Skylight
looks_6.summary: Deep cello-marimba earth waves push glowing mycelial roots up the 4 columns, cracking open the 29 ceiling coffers into starry Milky Way & rippling Aurora Borealis.

looks_6.hud_title: LOOK 2 (00:30-01:00): WEEPING WILLOW CATHEDRAL - Column Trunks, Draping Canopy & 3D Raking Sunbeams
looks_6.story_role: Beats 1-2 & 12 Signature Willow / Sunday Morning Wash
looks_6.summary: Ascending harp glissandi grow 4 ancient willow trunks up the columns; emerald fronds drape from the ceiling while golden-hour sunbeams rotate real 3D shadows across the plaster.

looks_6.hud_title: LOOK 3 (01:00-01:30): SUBMERGED SANCTUARY - Dome Water Drops, 3-Arch Waterfalls & Spring Caustics
looks_6.summary: Overhead water drops send concentric refractive shockwaves across the Dome, releasing 3 silky arched waterfalls, rising mist, and bioluminescent turquoise caustic waves.

looks_6.hud_title: LOOK 4 (01:30-02:00): TIME-LAPSE EDEN -> TIFFANY GLASS - Macro Floral Blooms Crystallizing into Stained Glass
looks_6.story_role: Beat 2 Botanical Growth & Beat 9/11 Sacred Artistry
looks_6.summary: Giant dewy magnolias, irises & lotuses unfurl on piano-harp swells before a radial crystalline chime-wave transforms the entire white chancel into backlit Tiffany Favrile glass.

looks_6.hud_title: LOOK 5 (02:00-02:30): FOUR SEASONS IN ONE BREATH - Frost Crystals -> Spring Thaw -> Rain Rainbow -> Autumn Gold
looks_6.story_role: Passage of Time Bridge / Contemplative Seasonal Wash
looks_6.summary: Ice chimes freeze dendritic frost along window arches; warm sun melts it into silver streams & blossoms; summer raindrops ripple into a rainbow; autumn wind drifts gold leaves onto ledges.

looks_6.hud_title: LOOK 6 (02:30-03:00): THE GREAT MIGRATION - Twilight Fireflies & 3D Monarch Swarms -> Tiffany Altar Mosaic
looks_6.story_role: Beats 11-12 Grand Emotional Finale (Butterflies -> Pixels -> Mosaic Tiles)
looks_6.summary: Twilight piano lantern chords pulse meadow fireflies; soaring choir & strings lift thousands of Monarchs & Swallowtails up to the Dome before locking wave-by-wave into the Last Supper Mosaic.
